<h1 align="center">SnapSlot</h1>

<p align="center"><b>Everything you copy, pinned to the top of your screen.</b><br>Copied images and selected text become notes along the top edge. Click one and it’s back on your clipboard.</p>

<p align="center">Windows 10 / 11 · macOS 13+ · Free and open source · No account · No uploads</p>

## How it works

<table>
<tr><td width="56%"><img src="../../docs/media/en/hero.webp" alt="Rest at the top edge"></td><td width="44%"><h3>Rest at the top edge</h3><p>Pause the pointer at the very top for half a second and the notes fan down. Move away and they leave. Scroll to turn the fan.</p></td></tr>
<tr><td width="44%"><h3>Drag it where you need it</h3><p>Hold a note and drop it into any app or folder as a PNG or TXT file.</p></td><td width="56%"><img src="../../docs/media/en/drag.webp" alt="Drag it where you need it"></td></tr>
<tr><td width="56%"><img src="../../docs/media/en/select.webp" alt="Select text, press the shortcut"></td><td width="44%"><h3>Select text, press the shortcut</h3><p>Select some text and press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> (Mac: <kbd>⌃</kbd> <kbd>⌥</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd>). It becomes a note, and the full text is copied too.</p></td></tr>
</table>

## Tray menu and settings

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%"><img src="../../docs/media/en/tray-menu.webp" alt="Tray menu"></td>
<td width="50%"><img src="../../docs/media/en/settings.webp" alt="Settings window"></td>
</tr>
</table>

Right-click the tray icon on Windows, or click the menu-bar icon on Mac: **Settings…**, **Collect clipboard images**, **Pin notes** (both checkable; with Pin on, notes stay open when the pointer leaves). Settings also change the look and language, show shortcuts, and clear everything. Quit SnapSlot is available at the bottom of the menu.

## Windows and macOS

<table>
<tr>
<td width="72%"><img src="../../docs/media/en/macos.webp" alt="macOS menu bar and Dock"></td>
<td width="28%"><img src="../../docs/media/en/phone.webp" alt="The demo on a phone"></td>
</tr>

Same notes and gestures on both; each uses its own system features natively. The website demo works on phones too.

## Shortcuts

| Action | Windows | macOS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Show / hide notes | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd> | <kbd>⌃</kbd> <kbd>⌥</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd> |
| Pin selected text | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> | <kbd>⌃</kbd> <kbd>⌥</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> |
| Choose / copy / remove / hide | <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> / <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Delete</kbd> / <kbd>Esc</kbd> | <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> / <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Delete</kbd> / <kbd>Esc</kbd> |

These are the defaults. Click a shortcut in Settings and press a new combination. Both bindings are checked at startup and when Settings opens, showing detected conflicts and available replacements before editing. Recording leaves other apps active and needs no Accessibility permission on Mac; collecting selected text does. Some shared shortcut registrations may not be detectable.

## Privacy

Collects images other apps write to the clipboard and text selected when you press the shortcut. No content is uploaded. Up to 30 notes; a normal exit clears the session.

## Build from source

```bash
# Website
npm ci --prefix apps/website
npm run dev --prefix apps/website -- --port 3000
```

```powershell
# Windows (.NET 10 SDK, Node.js 22+)
.\scripts\build-windows.ps1
.\artifacts\windows\win-x64\SnapSlot.exe
```

```bash
# macOS (Command Line Tools, Node.js 22+)
./scripts/build-macos.sh
open artifacts/macos/SnapSlot.app
```

Download the DMG / Setup installer above to install the app. Source-build outputs are intended for development. The Mac package is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; the system may block its first launch. See the [release and hosting guide](../../docs/releases/hosting.md).
